remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Sold to Duncan Phillips." Pictured in 1930 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 39. Titled *Ranchos Church, Taos* by Stieglitz on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph; reproduced in *Modern American Painters* (1930); reproduced and titled *Ranchos Church—New Mexico* in *Creative Art* (January 1931). See cat. nos. 661, 663–66,703–5, 1843, 1845, 1871, 1872. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A tan adobe wall with a gate frames a dark brown cross at the center of the composition. Beyond the cross, an adobe church with a black and white doorway rises above the gate. A small white cross emerges from the roof of the church. In the background, brown hills are visible beneath a bright blue sky.
title: Ranchos Church, Taos
